violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: COOKED SHRIMP AND RAW BEEF WERE PACKAGED SEPARATELY BUT BEING STORED TOGETHER IN THE SAME CONTAINER IN THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL RAW FOODS AND READY TO EAT FOODS NEED TO BE KEPT SEPARATE IN ORDER TO PREVENT POTENTIAL CONTAMINATION. PIC MOVED COOKED SHRIMP TO A HIGHER SHELF IN THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR, ABOVE THE RAW BEEF.

violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed an ambient air temperature above 45F in the following refrigeration unit holding raw shells eggs: EGGS WERE BEING STORED UNDERNEATH A PREP TABLE AT AMBIET TEMPERATURE.
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT EGGS NEED TO BE STORED AT 41F OR BELOW. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE MOVE EGGS BACK TO WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR TO COOL TO 41F.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were found subject to contamination after receipt and during storage due to the condition as described: A CONTAINER OF FRIED WONTON STRIPS WERE BEING STORED UNDER THE SHELF THAT ALL DIRTY DISHES ARE PLACED ON BEFORE BEING PUT IN THE DISH WASHER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT FOODS CANNOT BE STORED UNDERNEATH DIRTY DISHES. THE FOOD COULD POTENTIALLY BECOME CONTAMINATED WITH REMNANTS OF OLD FOOD FROM OTHERS DISHES. PIC REMOVED WONTON STRIPS FROM UNDERNEATH THE SHELF WITH RHE DIRTY DISHES ON IT.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC WHY HAND SOAP IS NEEDED AT EACH HAND SINK. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE REFILL THE HAND SOAP.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC WHY PAPER TOWLES ARE NEEDED AT EACH HAND SINK. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE REFILL THE PAPER TOWELS.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Multiple food items in the walk-in refrigerator were being stored on the floor.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PLEASE DO NOT STORE FOOD ON THE FLOOR. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC WHY FOOD SHOULD NEVER BE STORED ON THE FLOOR. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE BEGIN MOVING FOOD OFF OF THE FLOOR IN THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR.

violations.title: Food Storage No Contamination
violations.observation: Multiple food items are being kept in plastic bags that are not food safe.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food where it is not exposed to splash, dust or other contamination. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC WHY FOODS CANNOT BE STORED IN BAGS THAT ARE NOT FOOD SAFE. PLEASE BEGIN ONLY USING FOOD GRADE SAFE BAGS FOR FOOD STORAGE AND PLEASE GET RID OF THE PLASTIC BAGS BEFORE THE TIME OF THE NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not durable: one of the prep tables had cardboard being used under a cutting board.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT CARDBOARD CANNOT BE USED DUE TO ITS INABILITY TP BE PROPERLY WASHED, RINSED AND SANITIZED. PIC HAD EMPLOYEE THROW AWAY THE CARDBOARD ON THE PREP TABLE. SAMPAN CAFE (Inspection Date: 07/14/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: The floor in walk-in refrigerator is dirty to sight and touch.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PLEASE DEEP CLEAN THE FLOORS IN THE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR BY NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Dead or Trapped Pest Removed
violations.observation: Observe mouse droppings at the facility.
violations.corrective_action: Remove dead rodents, birds, and insects from the premises to ensure that the establishment is clean and sanitary and to prevent carcasses from attracting other pests. All areas observe with mouse droppings was removed and reclean.
